parsed.rationale: Sinus rhythm with very deep S waves in V2-V3 and tall R waves in V4-V5 (SV2+RV5 well over 35 mm) and left axis deviation; the concave ST elevation in V1-V3 with upright T waves is the expected secondary repolarization change of LVH, with no reciprocal ST depression or Q waves to suggest acute STEMI.
